Your workflows list shows the active count directly, and each workflow's enrolment trigger is on its first step.

migration-accelerator/capabilities/platforms/hubspot.yaml — automation.workflows, "HubSpot's orchestration primitive, equivalent in role to Eloqua Campaign Canvas / SFMC Journey Builder", and entry_sources' webhook_or_api_enrolment, which is the trigger class that makes a footprint expensive to rebuild rather than merely large. The base wording counted "journeys or automated programs", which is the target's word for the same thing and which a HubSpot marketer has to translate before answering. THE BAND EDGES ARE UNCHANGED (20 / 80): this is a rewording plus a trigger-mix recalibration, not a new scale, so a 2 here and a 2 on an Eloqua estate still describe comparably sized estates — which is the whole reason GTM_Assessment_Request__c.Estate_Complexity_Basis__c can put a self-estimate and a post-scan measurement on one axis. Kept strictly to COUNT AND TRIGGER MIX so it does not restate slot 3, which asks how much of the workflow LOGIC survives Journey Builder; skills/mce-mcn-helper/references/skills/03-org-scoring.md is the count-the-artefacts method both halves come from.
